description:
2-Bedroom Townhouse

Key Features: 

Bright one-bed with floor-to-ceiling windows 

Private balcony or terrace 

Sleek kitchen with integrated appliances 

Access to landscaped courtyard garden 

Video entry and fob-access 

Secure bike storage; optional gated parking* 

Pet-friendly apartments  

Friendly on-site concierge team on hand to help   

Community social events  

 

Local Highlights: 

Close to transport links and amenities 

4-minute walk to Queen's Road Peckham  

8-minute train London Bridge 

 

Detailed Descriptions:  

Enjoy a home where calm meets convenience. This one-bedroom apartment boasts an open-plan layout and a private balcony or terrace.  

Our apartments are finished to a high specification, perfect for solos and couples. You'll be coming home to a beautifully designed, open-plan home that has all the bells and whistles such as fully integrated appliances, ample storage, large windows, private balcony or terrace, spacious bedrooms and modern bathrooms.  

While you're just minutes from Queen's Road, Peckham and Zone 2 Overground and rail connections, you'll find an escape in our communal gardens. A short stroll from nearby galleries, cafes and restaurants, you'll find the perfect balance at Idaline Court.  

You'll be joining a close-knit community, with a friendly on-site team on hand to help - whether it's a maintenance request or advice about the best brunch spot. Get to know your neighbours with our calendar of outdoor events - designed to make the most of the garden courtyard. 

Please note: All images, floorplans, and particulars included are for illustrative and indicative purposes only. Individual features and layout may vary. *Car parking available at an additional fee.
keyFeatures: Townhouse-style apartment (multi-level layout typical of duplex homes)
